questions.cardDe: In welchem Land ist der 1. Mai kein gesetzlicher Feiertag: Finnland, Großbritannien oder Portugal?
questions.de: Auf welchen Tag fällt in Großbritannien der Feiertag „Early May Bank Holiday“, der dort statt des 1. Mai begangen wird?
questions.en: On which day does the Early May Bank Holiday, observed in Britain instead of 1 May, fall?

timeline.labelEn: The Early May bank holiday (first Monday in May) is introduced throughout the United Kingdom
timeline.labelDe: Der Early May Bank Holiday (erster Montag im Mai) wird im ganzen Vereinigten Königreich eingeführt

source.title: Public holidays in the United Kingdom

questions.notes: The card's answer is Great Britain: 1 May itself is no public holiday there; the bank holiday is the first Monday in May (since 1978; moved to 8 May in 1995 and 2020 for VE Day anniversaries).

questions.notes: Card misspells Barrie as 'Barry' (kept verbatim in cardDe). The statement is commonly held true but disputed: Wendy is recorded earlier (e.g. a 17th-century Captain Wendy Oxford); Barrie made it popular as a girl's name. Margaret was the daughter of poet W. E. Henley.

questions.en: When is white asparagus harvested so that, unlike green asparagus, it stays white?
questions.answerEn: Before it reaches the soil surface

timeline.labelEn: Asparagus cultivation in Germany is documented again, as an expensive delicacy
timeline.labelDe: Der Spargelanbau ist in Deutschland wieder belegt, als teure Delikatesse

questions.notes: Card statement is essentially true: the colour comes largely from the harvest method; white shoots are cut underground before light turns them green (though growers also prefer certain varieties for white asparagus).
